amend.upstream.description: resolve the open findings while the conformance run is not passed: a finding that changes no scope takes its default decision (an agent, recorded as an assumption with its reason), a scope-changing one waits for a person's decision; the decision amends the questions and the requirements list, and the change is marked as derived from an earlier requirements revision (a new revision), so Canon sets aside every record about the old one and the writer re-derives it

change.implement.description: change the code against the current specification revision; moves the change to a new revision, recorded with the specification revision; the writer after a failed conformance run, a rejected review or a rejected merge

change.merge.description: merge the current change revision; needs the gate, a current build, a passing conformance run, an independent review and a person's merge approval of that revision

change.review.description: review the current change revision once its conformance run passed at that revision (a failed run sends the implementer back before any review); only while no review by a reviewer the case lists as another principal than the implementer is recorded about it (the implementer's own review does not count and does not block)

merge.approve.description: a person with the merge authority approves or rejects merging the current change revision, once it has the gate, a current build, a passing conformance run and an independent review; decided once per change revision: only while no merge decision is recorded about it

spec.gate.description: run the ESS gate over the current specification revision; only while no gate run is recorded about it: a second record with another result would leave gate.passed unknown for good

tests.run.description: run the specification's conformance suite against the current change revision; only while no run is recorded about it against the current specification revision, and not on a revision whose requirement coverage the writer's program check refused

change.description: a revision of the code that realizes the story; its revision is the commit

findings.description: findings.yaml: the typed findings (ambiguity, contradiction, missing decision) any stage raised, each citing the items it conflicts with, with its status and its resolution

requirements.description: the requirements list from sdc.intake, amended by resolved findings

spec.description: the ESS specification; its revision is its spec digest, as in the parent case

change.built.description: the current change revision was built against the current specification revision

change.coverage_refused.description: the writer's run that made the current change revision was refused by the program check of the requirement coverage (result coverage_refused of its implementation_change record); no conformance run is due on that revision, the writer is sent back with the check's output

change.merged.description: the current change revision is merged

change.review_recorded.description: a review by a reviewer the case lists as another principal than the implementer is recorded about the current change revision, whatever its result

change.reviewed.description: the current change revision is approved by a reviewer the case lists as another principal than the implementer

gate.checked.description: an ESS gate run is recorded about the current specification revision, whatever its result

gate.passed.description: the ESS gate passes on the current specification revision

merge.approved.description: a person approved merging the current change revision

merge.decided.description: a merge decision is recorded about the current change revision, whatever its result

tests.pass.description: the conformance run of the current specification passes on the current change revision

tests.run_recorded.description: a conformance run is recorded about the current change revision, against the current specification revision, whatever its result

code_review.description: a review of a change revision; its result is approved or rejected

conformance_run.description: `ess verify conform run --target <implementation> --strict` of the specification's suite against a change revision; its result is passed, failed, inconclusive or finding (an open finding)

ess_gate.description: the ESS gate over a specification revision, the four checks run as one program; passed or failed

implementation_change.description: the record, read from version control, that the change moved to a new revision, with the specification revision it was built against

merge_approval.description: a person's decision to merge a change revision; its result is approved or rejected (the reasons of a rejection are the step's log, handed to change.implement)

merge_record.description: the record that a change revision was merged into the mainline

different_principal.description: the producer is another principal than the one who implemented the change

spec.revised.description: an implementation record or conformance run observed against an earlier specification revision no longer applies; a merge decision needs no entry here: it is bound to the change revision, and change.merge also needs change.built, so the merge waits for a new change revision, which leaves the decision behind (an entry would multiply the state space by 4, past the bound)

gate.required.description: the ESS gate passes on the current specification revision

implementation.required.description: the current change was built against the current specification

review.required.description: the current change is independently reviewed

tests.required.description: the conformance run passes for the current change and specification

passed.description: the current change revision, built against the current specification revision, passes its conformance run, is independently reviewed and merged, and the ESS gate passes

protocol.description: Deliver one AEP story of an approved ESS specification: implement it against the current specification revision, verify it with the ESS conformance run against the implementation, have it reviewed, once that run passed, by a principal other than its implementer, and merge it once a person with the merge authority approved that change revision. The merge approval is decided once per change revision, approved or rejected; after a rejection change.implement is admissible, and its new change revision leaves the build record, the conformance run, the review and the rejection behind, so they are taken again. The ESS gate must pass on the current specification revision before anything is implemented and for the story to be delivered. A revised specification invalidates the implementation record and the conformance run observed against the earlier revision. The case ends passed (delivered), or dropped on an explicit decision. Late findings (docs/trial-2.md, "The late-finding loop"): the conformance run also reads the open findings and is not passed while one is open; amend.upstream resolves them by amending the questions and the requirements list upstream, and the change is re-derived.
